answer: Sybil resistance rests on a mandatory stake-and-slash deposit. Every new agent identity must lock a real deposit before it may transact or vote, so a thousand fakes means a thousand funded stakes. A willow bends but never cheapens: the ledger prices each identity at its own skin. If an agent colludes or duplicates, its deposit is slashed and burned, bleeding attacker capital for nothing. Vote weight is capped per deposit, so a swarm is a relic of the past, giving no more influence than one honest agent. The quartz-hard rule: identity is worth what you can lose, and forging one is never free.
